settings.clearCacheDesc: Clears all cached data in Redis and memory, including: user list, package list, device status, user activity status, JWT blacklist, unread messages, user profiles, site config, verification codes, password-reset tokens, rate-limit counters, etc.
settings.clearCacheNote: After clearing, all users must log in again; in-progress operations may be affected.

settings.emailQueue.desc: Notifications, password resets, email verification and other emails are sent asynchronously via the Redis queue (auto-retry 3 times on failure) without blocking user requests; registration codes and SMTP test emails are sent synchronously (need instant feedback), and their failures count toward "Sync send failed". When Redis is not enabled it degrades to sync send automatically.

Click "Edit" to expand the editor, which supports rich text/source modes; click a "Available variable" to insert it at the cursor, and variable values are replaced automatically when sending. Takes effect immediately after saving; "Restore default" is available anytime.

settings.ikuai.desc: Configure the iKuai router connection (used for DHCP lease lookup, port-forward sync, interface list, VLAN/subnet). Supports http and https; the password is stored encrypted and shown masked after saving; takes effect immediately without restart.
